//copy: Who writes the words on each site. provider is anthropic, gemini, groq, or custom. Gemini and Groq have free tiers and need no card; Anthropic costs about 3 cents a business and writes the best copy. model and base_url are optional overrides — custom needs base_url, the address of any OpenAI-compatible API ending in /v1.
//stripe: Read-only is enough: nothing here writes to Stripe, it reconciles what Stripe says against what we think.
//invoicing: Invoices are raised and printed by this tool and paid however you and the client already agreed — there is no service behind it. tax_rate is only charged once tax_number is filled in: you may not collect GST/HST unless you are registered, and most people under $30k a year are not. Fill in at least one of e_transfer_email or cheque_payable_to, or the invoice prints with no way to pay it.
